title: Greer's Joe Rogan episode removed for Spotify
summary: Steven Greer tells of Greer's Joe Rogan episode removed for Spotify, about c. 2020 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, he in order to get his money from Spotify, they had to take it out.

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who calls for UFO disclosure, tells Jesse Michels' podcast that his episode on Joe Rogan's show, one of the biggest podcasts, was taken down around 2020. Greer says that Rogan had to remove it in order to get his money from Spotify, the streaming company that signed him. If true, it would mean business pressure pulled a UFO conversation from public view.
